# Field models — attribution

Models from Sketchfab, retrieved through the Objaverse mirror (huggingface.co/datasets/allenai/objaverse).
Each is licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Embedded images were removed and the
base colours the environment uses were saved at reduced size (tools/Prepare-FieldModels.py); geometry is unmodified.
Scale and placement are adjusted when the environment is generated.

- `goal.glb` — "Gary Fixter Football Goal" by garyfixter — https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/3001e42d65d3486ba56da3a36d6e5219
- `bleachers.glb` — "Sports Bleachers" by justice2free — https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/10a22c724d1a4083bab2d64cdbac6f01
- `poplar.glb`, `poplar_bark_color.jpg`, `poplar_leaves_color.png` — "POPLAR TREE - HIGHT TEXTURE LOW-POLY MODEL" by evseevdaniil0011 — https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/ec7c1d301bbc43dca5fe5f0650148d13

Pitch turf photographs (`pitch_turf_color.jpg`, `pitch_turf_normal.jpg`): "Grass005" by ambientCG, CC0 1.0 — https://ambientcg.com/view?id=Grass005
